subject: Matemática
description_pt: Reconhecer e representar, no plano cartesiano, o simétrico de figuras em relação aos eixos e à origem.

components.description_pt: Identificar a imagem refletida de uma figura em relação ao eixo x no plano cartesiano
components.description_en: Identify the reflected image of a figure across the x-axis in the Cartesian plane
components.cc_component_description: Describe the effect of reflection across the x- or y-axis on two-dimensional figures in the coordinate plane, including the use of coordinates and algebraic representation

components.description_pt: Representar a reflexão de uma figura em relação à origem no plano cartesiano
components.description_en: Represent the reflection of a figure across the origin in the Cartesian plane
components.cc_component_description: Describe the effect of rotations about the origin that are multiples of 90 degrees on two-dimensional figures in the coordinate plane, including the use of coordinates and algebraic representation

cc_matches.description: Describe the effect of dilations, translations, rotations, and reflections on two-dimensional figures using coordinates.
